title: Informative and well-delivered.  Easy walking.
text: Informative and well-delivered.  An local guide with a deeply embedded knowledge of the history of his city.  The walk followed the chronology of the city's development under successive invaders and settlers, giving an insight into origins of the modern Seville.
author: Robert C
